description: Election Commission - A. Nesathurai  was Selected as the member of the Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to a death, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
